finalists.label: Desmoplastic small round cell tumor
finalists.why: It has the strongest for evidence, including multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells with clear cytoplasm, diffuse strong WT1 positivity, and moderate, patchy CD99 positivity, with no against evidence.

finalists.label: Germ cell tumor
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including a 12 cm mass in the anterior superior mediastinum, multinodular proliferation of small, round, monomorphic cells with clear cytoplasm, and diffuse strong WT1 positivity, with no against evidence.

finalists.label: Superior vena cava syndrome
finalists.why: It has strong for evidence, including neck edema, distended neck veins, and facial plethora, and invasion of the superior vena cava above the azygos vein and thrombus extending into the left brachiocephalic trunk, with no against evidence.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive for evidence, including diffuse strong WT1 positivity and moderate, patchy CD99 positivity, which are unique to this diagnosis.
